title: Lead Network Architect - F5 LTM & GTM Load Balancers (English)
description:
ADP is searching for Senior Web Services & Security Architect to join its team. We are looking for highly technical, smart and flexible thinkers for whom problem solving is second nature. This role is primarily focused on the delivery of innovative web infrastructure solutions/ tools from concept to operations - particularly public and private cloud-based solutions, software defined infrastructure, and automation.

Typical Duties -

  • Support adoption of new Web Services Security technologies and tools, recommend capability improvements, and assist in lab/QA deployments for technology trials.
  • Participate in all facets of requirements gathering, prioritization, design, development, testing and execution (Proof of Concept) of Web Services engineering and security requests
  • Work closely with senior IT and business leaders to align IT activities with business strategy & objectives
  • Build strong cross-organizational relationships; effectively work with staff across the IT organization and the broader enterprise to align the network security technologies with overall organization needs
  • Liaise with vendors and service providers to identify and select the products or services that best support the organization's global network strategies
  • Provide Infrastructure performance and capacity guidance by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends
  • Identify emerging network & web security solutions and in coordination with Global Security, evaluate products
  • Regularly communicate the status of web services and network security initiatives to IT leadership and internal business partners
  • Be a mentor to other team members and lead through example by influencing the use of standards defined by the team and technical leadership

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science. Masters preferred.
  • Experience with Web Infrastructure Architecture, Application Security/Networking, or an applicable SRE/Cloud Engineering
  • Strong understanding of HTTPs protocols, DNS, SSL/TLS certificate management (integrating with internal processes)
  • Strong Understanding of PKI, Digital Certificates including but not limited to OpenSSL and Keytool commands for certificate creation, format conversion, export and import of certificates to the key stores, encoding and decoding of files, message level encryption as well Mutual TLS Authentication
  • Hands-On experience in Administration and management of F5 LTM & GTM Load balancers, and/or HA Proxy, NGINX, or Citrix load balancers
  • Strong Troubleshooting capabilities and log review experience using Splunk.
  • Linux (SLES and RHEL)
  • Experience with API Gateways (Layer7, APISIX etc..,) a plus
  • Experience with Cloud Web Application Firewalls & BOT Protection– Akamai, AWS WAF, Imperva, Cloudflare, F5 Shape a plus
  • Experience with Firewalls – Fortinet, Palo Alto a plus
  • Scripting/Automation experience a plus– Bash, Shell, Python, Ansible, Terraform etc..,
  • English Fluency

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

title: Senior Warehouse Supervisor - Guarulhos
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global fashion and lifestyle e-retailer committed to making fashion accessible to all. We use on-demand manufacturing technology to connect suppliers to our agile supply chain, reducing inventory waste and enabling us to deliver a variety of affordable products to customers around the world. From our global offices, we reach customers in 160 countries. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has nearly 17,000 employees operating from offices around the world, with its Brazil headquarters located in São Paulo.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Warehouse Supervisor to oversee daily logistics operations within a business unit, ensuring operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse activities across Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory , ensuring that operational processes are executed effectively and that teams are properly guided and supported to achieve business objectives.

The professional will also play an important role in monitoring operational performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, solving operational issues, and implementing corrective actions to enhance overall warehouse performance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise daily logistics operations within the assigned business unit, ensuring activities are completed within established deadlines and quality standards.
  • Lead and engage employees in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety, Quality, and Environmental policies , as well as company standards and procedures.
  • Ensure the effective execution and maintenance of existing operational processes, while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency.
  • Oversee key warehouse activities, including Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory , prioritizing and distributing tasks according to operational needs.
  • Provide guidance and support to the team, addressing operational challenges and resolving issues that may impact productivity, quality, or service levels.
  • Monitor operational progress and performance, identifying deviations and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance with SLAs, productivity targets, and quality standards .
  • Track and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), using data and logistics studies to identify trends, operational gaps, and opportunities to improve overall warehouse performance.
  • Coordinate physical inventory activities, ensuring proper execution and taking the necessary actions to maintain inventory accuracy.
  • Contribute to the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality standards within the area of responsibility.
  • Provide regular feedback, guidance, and performance insights to leaders and coordinators, supporting team development and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between logistics operations and broader business requirements.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management , or a related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in logistics or supply chain, preferably with experience in logistics operations, continuous improvement, distribution, supply chain, or demand planning.
  • Previous experience supervising or coordinating logistics or warehouse operations.
  • Strong problem-solving and data analysis skills , with the ability to interpret operational data and make sound, data-driven decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions to improve productivity, quality, and service levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional stakeholders .
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence.
  • Advanced English proficiency .
  • Availability to work shifts in Guarulhos .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in large-scale warehouse, fulfillment, distribution center, or e-commerce operations.
  • Experience with KPI management, operational performance analysis, inventory accuracy, and continuous improvement initiatives .
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working in high-volume and rapidly changing logistics environments.

title: Rewards Partner LATAM
description:
About the role

Leads the execution of the Total Rewards agenda across Latin America, translating strategy into impactful and scalable compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs that support Kerry's business and people priorities. This role partners closely with HR and business leaders to deliver market-competitive reward solutions, ensuring a seamless balance between employee experience, operational excellence, compliance, and cost effectiveness. Through strong stakeholder management, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement, the role drives consistent delivery, fosters cross-functional collaboration, and ensures Rewards programs create meaningful value for employees and the business.


Key responsibilities

Strategic Rewards Partner

  • Act as the trusted Rewards advisor to HR and business leaders across LATAM, translating global Rewards strategies into practical regional solutions that support business growth, talent priorities, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with HR Leadership Teams and business stakeholders to develop and execute Rewards programs that attract, retain, motivate, and engage talent while ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity.
  • Provide strategic guidance on compensation, benefits, recognition, incentive, and workforce planning matters, balancing business needs, employee experience, governance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Leverage market intelligence, analytics, and external benchmarking to identify trends, assess risks, and inform reward-related decisions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives, including restructures, acquisitions, integrations, and talent-related projects, ensuring Rewards considerations are effectively incorporated into business decisions.


Rewards Centre of Excellence Partner

  • Partner with Global Rewards and regional HR teams to implement and sustain Rewards programs, policies, frameworks, and governance across LATAM.
  • Drive the regional delivery of annual Rewards processes including salary reviews, incentive plans, market pricing, job architecture, pay transparency, and benefits governance.
  • Ensure Rewards programs remain compliant with local legislation, company policies, and regulatory requirements across the countries within scope.
  • Lead the assessment, design, and continuous improvement of Rewards programs to enhance employee value proposition, operational effectiveness, and cost management.
  • Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that improve understanding and adoption of Rewards programs among leaders, HR teams, and employees.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and coaching to HRBPs and people leaders on Rewards philosophy, policies, tools, and decision-making frameworks.


Business & Operational Execution

  • Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Global Rewards, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation of Rewards initiatives.
  • Support data-driven decision making through analysis, insights, and recommendations related to compensation, benefits, workforce costs, and talent outcomes.
  • Monitor Rewards program effectiveness through KPIs, market benchmarking, employee feedback, and governance reviews, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Drive high-quality execution of Rewards projects and processes, ensuring consistency, service excellence, and alignment with regional and global priorities.
  • Contribute to the development of regional guidelines, policies, and governance frameworks that enable scalable and sustainable Rewards practices across LATAM.


Qualifications and skills

• A Bachelor’s degree (Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or other applicable field)

• Minimum of ten (10) years broad based human resources experience, with significant experience at influencing; Experience in the food/flavours manufacturing industry desirable

• English, Portuguese and Spanish language capability (fluent in writing, speaking)


About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Coordenador(a) de Qualidade
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um profissional de Qualidade em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta vaga é para você.

Você será responsável por coordenar as atividades do time de Qualidade com responsabilidade pela gestão das pessoas, interfaces e qualidade das soluções técnicas.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Coordenar as atividades do Departamento da Qualidade, garantindo o atendimento aos requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001) e demais normas aplicáveis;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a equipe da Qualidade, distribuindo atividades, definindo prioridades e monitorando desempenho;
  • Gerenciar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs), analisando tendências e propondo planos de melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar auditorias internas, externas e de clientes, incluindo auditorias de organismos certificadores e clientes estratégicos;
  • Atuar como responsável pela manutenção do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, assegurando a atualização de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e registros;
  • Gerenciar o tratamento de Não Conformidades (internas, clientes e fornecedores), conduzindo análise de causa raiz, definição de ações corretivas e verificação de eficácia;
  • Coordenar o processo de homologação, avaliação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação;
  • Suportar processos de certificação e manutenção de certificados de produtos, acompanhando ensaios laboratoriais e documentação técnica junto aos órgãos certificadores;
  • Garantir a conformidade dos produtos com requisitos normativos, regulatórios e especificações de clientes;
  • Elaboração de Data Book – Petrobras;
  • Gerenciar processos de calibração de equipamentos de medição e monitoramento, garantindo rastreabilidade metrológica;
  • Coordenar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, assegurando o cumprimento dos critérios de aceitação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com Engenharia, Produção, Supply Chain e Atendimento ao Cliente na resolução de problemas de qualidade;
  • Suportar projetos de melhoria contínua utilizando ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e Lean Six Sigma;
  • Elaborar apresentações gerenciais, reportando indicadores, riscos e planos de ação à liderança.


Quem você é:

Você apresenta elevado nível de atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade, assegurando aderência rigorosa às diretrizes, instruções e padrões de processo estabelecidos pela organização. Combinando pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes, transmitindo mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa.. Você prevê conflitos antes que eles aconteçam, com base no conhecimento da dinâmica interpessoal e de grupo. A função exige, ainda, disciplina operacional, responsabilidade e zelo constante pelas pessoas, organização, segurança e ambiente de trabalho.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Qualidade, Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência com qualificação de fornecedores e auditorias de qualidade;
  • Inglês avançado (para contato com fornecedores internacionais);
  • Conhecimento da ISO 9001;
  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes na área de Qualidade e laboratório de Qualidade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas;
  • Local de trabalho: Barueri, SP.


Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão / Engenharia da Qualidade e Certificações relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e 6-Sigma;
  • Conhecimento em ERP Omega da ABC71
  • Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas
  • Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês


Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Atendente de recepção
description:
VAGA: ATENDENTE DE RECEPÇÃOSobre o CCD

O Centro de Cirurgia Digestiva do DF – CCD é uma clínica especializada em Cirurgia Digestiva, Gastroenterologia e Proctologia , que atua com foco em excelência técnica, segurança e atendimento humanizado.

Nossa equipe é formada por profissionais experientes e comprometidos com a qualidade do atendimento aos pacientes e seus familiares. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho organizado, colaborativo e respeitoso, no qual cada profissional tem papel fundamental para o bom funcionamento da clínica.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos Atendente de Recepção para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no acolhimento e atendimento aos pacientes, contribuindo para que sua experiência na clínica seja organizada, cordial e eficiente.

A profissional será responsável por:

  • Realizar atendimento presencial e telefônico aos pacientes e familiares;
  • Recepcionar e acolher os pacientes com cordialidade e atenção;
  • Realizar agendamentos, confirmações e orientações sobre consultas, exames e procedimentos;
  • Conferir e atualizar dados cadastrais;
  • Orientar pacientes quanto à documentação necessária para atendimento e realização de exames;
  • Organizar o fluxo de chegada e encaminhamento dos pacientes aos setores;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar autorizações junto aos planos de saúde;
  • Apoiar a organização de prontuários e documentos;
  • Prestar suporte administrativo às equipes médica e de enfermagem;
  • Manter a recepção organizada, limpa e abastecida com os materiais necessários;
  • Seguir os protocolos e procedimentos internos da clínica, preservando sempre o sigilo e a confidencialidade das informações dos pacientes .
Requisitos
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Perfil cordial, acolhedor e profissional;
  • Facilidade para lidar com pacientes, familiares e equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e responsabilidade;
  • Conhecimento básico de informática e sistemas de atendimento;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e seguir processos e protocolos;
  • Experiência com atendimento ao público e rotinas administrativas.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência anterior em recepção de clínicas, hospitais ou consultórios;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de agendamento e autorização de convênios;
  • Experiência com atendimento na área da saúde.
Carga horária

44 horas semanais

De segunda a sábado.

Modalidade: Presencial

Local: Brasília – DF

Benefícios
  • Vale-transporte: sem desconto de 6% do colaborador;

Se você se identifica com um ambiente de trabalho profissional, colaborativo e voltado para a qualidade no atendimento ao paciente , queremos conhecer você!

title: Production Engineer – Wireless Industrialization and Tax Processes Specialist
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Production Engineer or Industrialization Specialist to support the development and implementation of local manufacturing and assembly strategies for ZTE’s telecommunications products in Brazil.

The primary focus of this position will be to evaluate and enable the local production of Wireless RAN and Microwave (MW) equipment , including radio units, baseband units, antennas, transmission equipment, cabinets, power systems, accessories, and related components.

This professional will act as a key interface among Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Logistics, Finance, local manufacturing partners, and ZTE’s global teams.

The position requires a combination of industrial engineering, product-cost analysis, tax knowledge, and project coordination. The professional will be responsible for developing feasible local-production models, ensuring compliance with Brazilian industrial and tax regulations, and evaluating the effects of the Brazilian Tax Reform on manufacturing costs, tax credits, sourcing strategies, and product competitiveness.

Main Responsibilities

Local Production and Industrialization

  • Evaluate Wireless RAN and Microwave product families for potential local manufacturing, assembly, integration, configuration, testing, and repair in Brazil.
  • Develop industrialization strategies for radio units, baseband equipment, antennas, microwave radios, indoor and outdoor units, cabinets, power systems, and related telecom products.
  • Analyze different production models, including local manufacturing, outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing, CKD/SKD assembly, and partial localization of components.
  • Coordinate the implementation of local production projects from feasibility study through pilot production and mass production.
  • Define production workflows, assembly sequences, testing procedures, quality checkpoints, required tooling, labor demand, and factory capacity.
  • Prepare industrial process flowcharts, work instructions, technical reports, and project documentation.
  • Support prototype, pilot, first-article, and production-validation activities.
  • Monitor production performance, lead time, yield, quality indicators, manufacturing costs, and corrective-action plans.

Product Localization and Cost Analysis

  • Review product BOMs to identify opportunities for local sourcing, component substitution, process simplification, and cost reduction.
  • Develop localization roadmaps for selected Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Perform make-or-buy analyses and compare imported-product costs with local-production scenarios.
  • Prepare business cases covering investment requirements, production volume, manufacturing costs, tax impacts, logistics costs, and expected financial returns.
  • Identify Brazilian suppliers and manufacturing partners capable of meeting ZTE’s technical, quality, cost, capacity, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate technical alignment between Brazilian suppliers, outsourced factories, and ZTE’s global R&D and product teams.
  • Support negotiations with contract manufacturers and monitor their operational and contractual performance.

PPB, Regulatory Compliance and Incentives

  • Analyze and implement applicable Basic Productive Process (PPB) requirements for telecommunications and electronic products.
  • Evaluate industrial and regional incentive structures, including projects involving SUFRAMA and the Manaus Free Trade Zone , when applicable.
  • Monitor compliance with production stages, local-content requirements, investment commitments, documentation, and traceability obligations.
  • Support applications, technical projects, reports, and evidence required by government authorities and incentive programs.
  • Ensure alignment among BOM structure, manufacturing processes, import records, production orders, inventories, and tax documentation.
  • Support ANATEL-related product-compliance activities when they interact with industrialization, local configuration, or product modifications.
  • Assist internal and external audits and inspections conducted by SUFRAMA, Receita Federal, SEFAZ, and other regulatory authorities.

Tax Processes and Brazilian Tax Reform

  • Evaluate the tax impacts of local production versus importation for Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Support the correct classification of products, components, kits, and raw materials under the NCM .
  • Coordinate the preparation and validation of the FCI – Import Content Statement , when applicable.
  • Work closely with the Tax team to ensure the correct application and recovery of tax credits throughout the manufacturing and supply chain.
  • Analyze the effects of Brazil’s Tax Reform on industrialization projects, particularly the transition from the current tax system to CBS and IBS .
  • Assess how the new tax-credit model may affect product costs, local sourcing, contract manufacturing, inventory flows, transfers, imports, sales, and customer pricing.
  • Monitor the coexistence of legacy taxes and the new consumption-tax system during the transition period.
  • Support adaptations to ERP, costing, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, and tax-control processes required by the Tax Reform.
  • Analyze the effects of ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, CBS, IBS and, when applicable, the Selective Tax and regional tax incentives on industrial projects.
  • Maintain documentation and calculation models that allow ZTE to compare tax burdens and credit utilization under different production and sourcing scenarios.
  • Work with Tax, Finance, IT, and ERP teams to ensure the traceability of tax credits from component acquisition through production and final sale.
  • Monitor regulatory changes that may affect PPB rules, Manaus Free Trade Zone incentives, local manufacturing, imported content, or telecom-equipment taxation.

Systems, Inventory and Process Integration

  • Support the configuration and continuous improvement of industrial, inventory, purchasing, costing, and tax processes in ERP systems.
  • Ensure consistency among engineering BOMs, production BOMs, purchase orders, import systems, warehouse balances, production orders, and accounting records.
  • Support integrations and reconciliations involving PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, import-management systems, and other internal platforms.
  • Identify process gaps that may generate incorrect inventory balances, tax-credit losses, production delays, or accounting inconsistencies.
  • Participate in automation, data-analysis, and artificial-intelligence initiatives aimed at improving industrial planning, tax controls, documentation, and operational productivity.

Project Management and Cross-functional Coordination

  • Lead cross-functional industrialization projects involving Engineering, Product, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Finance, Logistics, Quality, IT, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Develop project schedules, define responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and report risks and progress to management.
  • Coordinate technical and commercial discussions with ZTE headquarters and international product teams.
  • Translate global product and manufacturing requirements into processes compatible with Brazilian industrial, tax, and regulatory conditions.
  • Present recommendations, business cases, risks, and project results to local and global leadership.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production-process implementation, or local assembly of electronic or telecommunications products.
  • Experience with BOM analysis, production workflows, cost structures, and outsourced manufacturing.
  • Practical knowledge of Brazilian taxes and industrial regulations related to manufacturing, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, NCM, FCI, and PPB.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its main operational impacts, especially CBS, IBS, tax-credit traceability, and the transition between tax systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including cost simulations, scenario analysis, reconciliations, and data processing.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications, BOMs, production documents, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.
  • Intermediate or advanced English for meetings, technical discussions, documentation, and interaction with ZTE’s global teams.
  • Availability to visit suppliers, factories, warehouses, and production partners when required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Wireless RAN, Microwave, telecommunications infrastructure, or radio-frequency equipment .
  • Knowledge of the architecture and main components of radio access and microwave-transmission systems.
  • Previous experience in the localization or nationalization of telecom or electronic products.
  • Experience with contract manufacturers, electronics manufacturing services, CKD/SKD operations, or outsourced assembly.
  • Experience with PPB projects, SUFRAMA, the Manaus Free Trade Zone, or other Brazilian industrial-incentive programs.
  • Knowledge of PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, MES, PLM, or other ERP and manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with product-costing methodologies, standard cost, landed cost, and manufacturing variance analysis.
  • Experience with ANATEL certification processes or other telecom regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, process mapping, quality tools, or project-management methodologies.
  • Experience using business-intelligence, automation, data-analysis, or artificial-intelligence tools.
  • Knowledge of Mandarin Chinese will be considered an advantage.


Requirement:

  • 7 years of experience in implementation in production, quality, supply chain, industrialization and tax;
  • Graduated in Engineering;
  • Fluent English.

Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs.


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Geração de Energia e Utilidades com sólida experiência em sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades industriais, perfil técnico, analítico e visão corporativa. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por atuar de forma estratégica na gestão técnica dos sistemas de geração de energia, vapor e utilidades, contribuindo para a eficiência, confiabilidade, segurança e melhoria contínua dos processos.

A posição terá atuação corporativa, promovendo a padronização de práticas e soluções técnicas entre as unidades, desenvolvendo padrões e especificações e apoiando a disseminação de conhecimentos e melhores práticas. Espera-se capacidade para estabelecer interface com diferentes áreas da organização, incluindo o time Comercial, traduzindo necessidades técnicas em soluções e contribuindo para decisões estratégicas relacionadas à geração de energia e utilidades.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atuar na gestão técnica dos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades: acompanhar e apoiar a operação dos sistemas de geração de energia, geração de vapor e demais utilidades industriais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria de desempenho, eficiência e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir a segurança e confiabilidade dos processos: atuar na identificação e mitigação de riscos relacionados aos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades, contribuindo para a segurança dos processos e a confiabilidade dos ativos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar padrões técnicos: elaborar, revisar e implementar padrões, especificações técnicas, editais e melhores práticas relacionadas aos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades, promovendo maior padronização entre as unidades.
  • Otimizar o desempenho energético: analisar balanços de energia, identificar oportunidades de redução de perdas e otimização do consumo e contribuir para a melhoria contínua da eficiência dos sistemas de geração.
  • Atuar na gestão de caldeiras e geração de vapor: acompanhar aspectos relacionados ao projeto, operação e desempenho de caldeiras, especialmente sistemas de geração de vapor a partir de biomassa.
  • Acompanhar sistemas de tratamento de água e balanço hídrico: atuar na avaliação e otimização dos processos de tratamento de água em torres e caldeiras, contribuindo para a melhoria do balanço hídrico e da eficiência operacional.
  • Promover a integração e padronização entre unidades: identificar sinergias, compartilhar boas práticas e apoiar a implementação de soluções técnicas comuns entre as diferentes unidades da companhia.
  • Atuar de forma corporativa e estratégica: estabelecer interface com áreas técnicas, operacionais e corporativas, incluindo o time Comercial, apoiando análises e decisões relacionadas à geração de energia e utilidades.
  • Desenvolver conhecimento e capacitar equipes: disseminar conhecimento técnico, apoiar a capacitação das equipes e promover a evolução das práticas relacionadas à geração de energia e utilidades.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Química ou Engenharia de Produção Mecânica.
  • Experiência em engenharia, geração de energia e/ou utilidades industriais.
  • Experiência sólida em sistemas de geração de energia, sendo este o principal foco da posição.
  • Conhecimento em geração de vapor e utilidades industriais.
  • Conhecimento em caldeiras de biomassa, incluindo projeto e operação.
  • Conhecimento em balanço de energia e eficiência energética.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de processos e confiabilidade de ativos.
  • Conhecimento em tratamento de água em torres e caldeiras.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em otimização e melhoria do balanço hídrico.
  • Conhecimento de padrões técnicos, normas e melhores práticas aplicáveis aos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e implementação de padrões técnicos e especificações.
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambiente corporativo e de interação com diferentes áreas e stakeholders.
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico, colaborativo e com forte capacidade de comunicação e influência.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em ambientes industriais de grande porte, especialmente energia, agronegócio, açúcar e etanol, papel e celulose, química ou outros segmentos com geração própria de energia.
  • Vivência em geração de energia a partir de biomassa.
  • Experiência em atuação corporativa com interface entre diferentes unidades industriais.
  • Conhecimento em projetos de otimização energética e melhoria de eficiência de sistemas de geração.
  • Experiência na definição de padrões, especificações técnicas e contratação de soluções/serviços técnicos.
  • Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas unidades e necessidade de padronização de processos e melhores práticas.


Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Job Overview: 

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.


Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.


Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students’ progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.


Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.


Other duties, as assigned.


Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up


POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:  

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.


EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Change Management Manager
description:
About the role

You are accountable for the model itself — that it works, that it is documented, and that it earns the right to scale. Help select the rest of the squad. A team assembled before its manager arrives inherits someone else’s judgement about fit, and this manager will be held accountable for the D+90 recommendation either way.


What you'll do

  • Own the playbook: define the methodology, document it, and enforce quality on it across both pilots.
  • Protect the squad from being used as generic capacity. Refuse work that does not move partner adoption, and make that refusal visible rather than quiet.
  • Manage senior individual contributors who work outside the building — a genuinely different problem from managing a co-located team.
  • Hold nine pillar owners to commitments they did not originally make.
  • Help select every other seat on the squad. Fit is your call, not a hand-me-down.
  • Know at day 60 whether the pilot is going to fail — leading indicators, not lagging ones — and be willing to recommend stopping.
  • Treat your calendar as a lever: more time from this leader on the programme moves success probability more than a budget increase of similar size.


What you'll need

  • Strong experience in transformation leadership, consulting practice management, or a senior commercial role carrying a change portfolio.
  • Experience managing senior individual contributors who work outside the building.
  • Executive influence across functional boundaries; able to hold senior owners to commitments they did not originally make.
  • Methodology ownership: able to define a playbook and enforce quality on it.
  • Strong English and Spanish (both written and spoken).


Desirable

  • Has built a team from zero before.
  • Change-management certification (Prosci, CCMP, APMG or HCMBOOK) — for credibility with the practitioners they will manage, not as a gate.


More about you

  • You manage remotely without surveilling.
  • You kill work that does not move adoption.
  • Strong sounds like: leading indicators at day 60, and a willingness to recommend stopping.

title: Tax Manager
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the company’s tax compliance for corporate, VAT, payroll, withholding, and local taxes.
  • Review and file tax returns on time, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local regulations
  • Support tax planning for wind farm development, construction, operation, and asset transfers.
  • Analyze tax impacts of project contracts, financing structures, PPAs, land leases, EPC agreements, and O&M contracts.
  • Coordinate tax audits, inquiries, and inspections from tax authorities.
  • Work with Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Project teams on the tax treatment of transactions.
  • Identify tax incentives, exemptions, and benefits applicable to renewable energy projects.
  • Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.
  • Supervise external tax advisors and ensure deliverables are met.
  • Prepare tax reports for management and support accounting closing processes.
  • Act as the Tax key user for SAP implementation and enhancement projects,supporting tax requirements, system configuration, testing, data validation, and integration with Finance, Procurement, and other relevant modules.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of tax processes, controls, and automation within SAP.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Tax, Law, or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of local tax legislation and compliance processes.
  • Experience in tax management, preferably in energy, infrastructure, construction, or manufacturing.
  • Understanding of project-based businesses and long-term investment structures.
  • Ability to analyze tax implications of contracts and complex transactions.
  • Strong Excel and Financial Analysis Skills.
  • Experience working with external auditors and tax authorities.
  • Good communication skills to work across technical, legal, and finance teams.
  • High attention to detail, organization, and deadline management.
  • English proficiency is required.


Job Location

  • Sao Paulo - Nearby Morumbi Mall

title: User Operations Manager
description:
About the role

This role sits at the intersection of operations, product, data, and business strategy. You'll own the full operational engine behind key consumption moments.

You'll work across Merchant Ops, Courier Ops, Product, CRM, Customer Experience, and Marketing, requiring strong cross-functional coordination and a bias for action.

Job Responsabilities

Core Initiatives Identification & Design

  • Identify, validate, and prioritize core consumption moments
  • Build a structured framework to map demand opportunities and guide development priorities
  • Develop playbooks
  • Conduct competitor analysis and benchmarks
  • Design and execute user surveys to understand pain points and behavioral drivers
  • Translate data insights into operational actions and strategic recommendations

User Operations

  • Own the full execution cycle: Ideation → kickoff → planning → 360 Coordintation→ launch → performance tracking → iteration
  • Manage and Optimizate budget
  • Coordination with Marketing, Product, CRM, and Resources teams
  • Act as a liaison between various stakeholders (Product, Marketing, Business, Data, Customer Experience, Delivery) to ensure a 360-degree view of the customer

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields
  • 5+ years of robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms
  • Background in e-commerce, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact
  • Experience with CRM platforms and communication channel management
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills, preferrably previous experience with Product and Martech
  • Excellent communication skills to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to balance user delight with business impact


Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Analista de operações
description:
Sobre o IBF


O IBF (Instituto Brasileiro de Florestas) atua com silvicultura de madeiras nobres desde 2006. Com sede em Londrina/PR e operação em Minas Gerais, tornou-se referência nacional no setor.


Estamos construindo uma cultura AI-first e buscamos pessoas que queiram aprender, assumir responsabilidades e melhorar processos.


Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um(a) Analista de Operações e Customer Success para organizar, acompanhar e aprimorar a operação do departamento responsável pelo relacionamento, sucesso e suporte pós-venda aos clientes.


A posição responderá diretamente à diretoria e apoiará três profissionais de Customer Success. Será responsável pela organização dos processos, operação do CRM, governança dos dados, controle de relatórios, acompanhamento dos indicadores e integração entre Customer Success, Operações Florestais, Financeiro, Comercial e Diretoria.


A função será predominantemente de bastidor. Entretanto, poderá realizar contatos específicos com clientes para envio de relatórios, aplicação de pesquisas de satisfação, atualização cadastral, cobrança de documentos ou contratos, confirmação de recebimento e outros procedimentos pontuais.


Missão da função


Garantir que os processos, dados, ferramentas, relatórios e fluxos da jornada pós-venda estejam organizados, mensurados e executados conforme as diretrizes da diretoria, apoiando a equipe de Customer Success, identificando riscos e propondo melhorias contínuas na experiência, retenção e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades


• Organizar e acompanhar a operação diária do departamento de Customer Success;

• Administrar o fluxo do pós-venda no CRM e nos demais sistemas utilizados pela empresa;

• Manter atualizados os cadastros, históricos, documentos e informações dos clientes;

• Realizar a segmentação dos clientes conforme os critérios estabelecidos pela diretoria;

• Organizar e acompanhar o onboarding de novos clientes;

• Apoiar a distribuição das carteiras, demandas e atividades entre os profissionais de Customer Success;

• Controlar registros de contatos, reuniões, solicitações, providências e retornos;

• Identificar clientes sem acompanhamento, registros incompletos, atividades vencidas e demandas sem resolução;

• Cobrar dos responsáveis a atualização das informações e o cumprimento dos procedimentos;

• Acompanhar pendências operacionais, técnicas, cadastrais e contratuais;

• Articular demandas com Operações Florestais, Financeiro, Comercial, Jurídico e demais áreas responsáveis;

• Apoiar os processos de renovação, retenção, indicação, upsell e cross-sell;

• Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias na jornada pós-venda;

• Organizar o calendário de relatórios periódicos enviados aos clientes;

• Reunir dados e cobrar informações das áreas responsáveis;

• Controlar responsáveis, prazos, aprovações, versões e histórico dos relatórios;

• Redigir, revisar, adaptar e diagramar relatórios e comunicações;

• Submeter os conteúdos técnicos à validação de Operações Florestais e da diretoria;

• Conferir dados, documentos, anexos, links e informações antes do envio;

• Apoiar os profissionais de Customer Success no envio e na apresentação dos relatórios;

• Realizar eventualmente o envio direto de materiais aos clientes;

• Realizar contatos específicos com clientes quando necessário;

• Apoiar pesquisas de NPS, CSAT e outras avaliações de satisfação;

• Apoiar a cobrança de contratos, aditivos e demais documentos;

• Apoiar ações e campanhas de relacionamento, retenção e engajamento;

• Organizar listas e segmentações de clientes para comunicações específicas;

• Criar, manter e aprimorar o health score da carteira de clientes;

• Classificar clientes conforme seu nível de relacionamento, engajamento e risco;

• Identificar clientes sem contato recente, insatisfeitos, inadimplentes ou com demandas recorrentes;

• Identificar riscos de cancelamento, reclamações e situações que exijam intervenção;

• Auditar registros de atendimentos, reuniões, mensagens, e-mails e demais interações;

• Verificar qualidade, clareza, completude, postura e cumprimento dos procedimentos;

• Organizar contratos, aditivos, documentos e informações cadastrais;

• Controlar vencimentos, reajustes, renovações e assinaturas;

• Apoiar a interlocução com o Financeiro em situações de inadimplência;

• Criar, atualizar e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais;

• Consolidar os indicadores da jornada pós-venda;

• Conferir a integridade, consistência e atualização dos dados;

• Preparar relatórios semanais e periódicos para a diretoria;

• Criar e atualizar scripts, modelos de e-mail, apresentações, pesquisas, formulários e checklists;

• Documentar processos e manter atualizados os playbooks e manuais do departamento;

• Apoiar a integração e o treinamento de novos profissionais de Customer Success.


Indicadores acompanhados


O profissional participará da consolidação e evolução de indicadores como:


• Clientes ativos e carteiras por responsável;

• Onboardings iniciados, pendentes e concluídos;

• Tempo de conclusão do onboarding;

• Cobertura e frequência de contato com a carteira;

• Clientes sem acompanhamento;

• Demandas abertas, concluídas e vencidas;

• Backlog, tempo de primeira resposta, tempo de resolução e cumprimento dos SLAs;

• Relatórios previstos, entregues e atrasados;

• NPS, CSAT e demais indicadores de satisfação;

• Reclamações, reincidências e motivos de insatisfação;

• Health score e distribuição dos clientes por nível de risco;

• Retenção, churn, cancelamentos, renovações e indicações;

• Oportunidades de upsell, cross-sell e receita de expansão;

• Reembolsos, inadimplência e pendências documentais ou contratuais;

• Qualidade e completude dos registros;

• Aderência aos processos e produtividade da equipe.


Não é necessário que o candidato já domine todos esses indicadores. Espera-se capacidade analítica e disposição para aprendê-los progressivamente com o apoio da diretoria e da equipe.


Sistemas, inteligência artificial e automações


• Operar e manter atualizados o Pipedrive, Zana, WhatsApp corporativo, e-mail, ERP, Google Workspace, Slack e o sistema florestal próprio da empresa;

• Apoiar a integração e o fluxo de informações entre os diferentes sistemas;

• Utilizar inteligência artificial para análise, redação, revisão, classificação e consolidação de informações;

• Criar e aprimorar prompts e assistentes para apoiar a equipe;

• Desenvolver automações para atividades recorrentes;

• Automatizar alertas de risco, pendências, vencimentos e prazos;

• Garantir que o uso das ferramentas respeite as políticas de segurança e confidencialidade.


Qualificações


• Graduação completa ou em andamento em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Comunicação, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas relacionadas;

• Interesse ou experiência em Customer Success, atendimento, relacionamento ou pós-venda;

• Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes;

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Capacidade de redigir e revisar relatórios e comunicações;

• Raciocínio analítico e facilidade para trabalhar com indicadores;

• Facilidade para organizar tarefas, prazos, documentos e diferentes responsáveis;

• Capacidade de transformar diretrizes em processos, checklists e rotinas;

• Facilidade para trabalhar com planilhas, dashboards e sistemas de gestão;

• Perfil responsável, proativo, criterioso e comprometido com prazos;

• Postura profissional para lidar com informações sensíveis e clientes de alta renda;

• Disposição para documentar processos e propor melhorias;

• Interesse e facilidade para utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial.


Diferenciais


• Experiência em Customer Success, pós-venda, atendimento ou relacionamento com clientes;

• Experiência em operações, suporte administrativo ou gestão de processos;

• Conhecimento de Pipedrive ou outros sistemas de CRM;

• Experiência com Zana, ERP ou sistemas semelhantes;

• Familiaridade com indicadores de satisfação, retenção e churn;

• Experiência com dashboards, health score e classificação de risco;

• Experiência com contratos, documentos e relatórios;

• Conhecimento de auditoria ou controle de qualidade de atendimentos;

• Experiência com documentação de processos, playbooks e manuais;

• Familiaridade com automações e integrações entre sistemas;

• Bom repertório no uso profissional de ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot ou ferramentas semelhantes.


Não é necessário conhecer previamente o setor florestal. O conhecimento técnico será desenvolvido internamente.


Remuneração e benefícios


• Salário fixo de R$ 3.500,00;

• Vale-transporte;

Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF.

title: Head of Operations & Strategic Projects
description:
Missão da Vaga:


Buscamos um(a) Head de Operações e Projetos Estratégicos com perfil prático e sólida experiência em gestão de projetos para liderar a implementação, estruturação e operação contínua de nossos negócios no Brasil. Este(a) profissional será responsável por impulsionar a execução multifuncional, estruturar e monitorar rigorosamente as principais entregas, remover obstáculos, garantir a responsabilidade entre as equipes e traduzir as prioridades estratégicas em execução. Gerenciará conexões e parcerias estratégicas com bancos e instituições financeiras, além de lidar diretamente com os relacionamentos regulatórios e operacionais com o Banco Central do Brasil (BACEN).


Perfil:


  • Desenhar e supervisionar a execução operacional de fluxos de pagamentos transfronteiriços (Cross-Border Payments ), englobando operações de Câmbio (FX), Comércio Exterior (Comex) e eFX, garantindo conformidade regulatória e eficiência na liquidação internacional.
  • Monitoramento de Entregas e Projetos (Gestão de Entregas): Responsável pela governança da execução de iniciativas operacionais e de produto essenciais, estruturando e impulsionando o pipeline de entregas, definindo marcos e responsáveis, identificando e removendo proativamente obstáculos e garantindo a responsabilidade, a priorização e a execução dentro do prazo.
  • Gestão da Execução Operacional (Prática): Projetar, implementar e otimizar os fluxos de trabalho operacionais da empresa com foco em eficiência, escalabilidade, automação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Parcerias Bancárias, Bandeiras de Cartão e Institucionais: Prospectar, estruturar e gerenciar a conectividade operacional e as parcerias que sustentam os fluxos de pagamento e liquidação da empresa, incluindo: Parceiros Bancários, Relacionamento com Adquirentes, Bandeiras de Cartão e Parcerias Estratégicas.
  • Interação Prática com o Banco Central do Brasil (BACEN): Participar ativamente do relacionamento institucional e operacional com o BACEN, representando a empresa em reuniões diretas com o órgão regulador, coordenando respostas a processos de supervisão, auditorias, inspeções e solicitações formais.
  • Governança Operacional e Conformidade: Desenvolver e manter fluxos de trabalho, manuais operacionais, rotinas de controle interno e políticas de mitigação de riscos em conformidade com os padrões exigentes do ecossistema financeiro regulamentado.
  • Liderança Interfuncional: Orquestrar a viabilidade operacional de soluções e novos fluxos em conjunto com as equipes globais e locais de Produto, Tecnologia, Finanças, Jurídico e Conformidade.
  • Interface Comercial (Plus): Apoiar técnica e estrategicamente iniciativas comerciais quando necessário, auxiliando no desenho operacional de contratos e soluções estruturadas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar como Oficial Estatutário perante o Banco Central do Brasil (BACEN).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência Executiva Sênior e Prática: Histórico sólido com perfil de construtor e atuação prática em posições de liderança em Operações, Gerenciamento de Projetos ou PMO em Fintechs, Instituições de Pagamento (IPs), Provedores de Pagamento ou Instituições Financeiras.
  • Gerenciamento de Projetos e Acompanhamento de Roadmap: Forte experiência no acompanhamento do ciclo de vida de entrega de projetos complexos, gerenciamento de cronogramas e facilitação da comunicação entre as equipes de operações, produto e desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência atuando diretamente com o Banco Central do Brasil (BACEN): incluindo participação em reuniões presenciais/remotas com a autoridade, resposta a auditorias, inspeções regulatórias, processos de supervisão ou solicitações regulatórias formais.
  • Experiência em Mesa de Câmbio e Operações Cross-boarder: Compreensão profunda do ecossistema de câmbio e cross-boarder payments.
  • Experiência na implantação de: PIX, sistemas de pagamento, liquidação, câmbio e experiência prática em negociação, conexão e operacionalização de parcerias com bancos e instituições financeiras.
  • Conhecimento Comercial (Desejável): Habilidades em relacionamento comercial e/ou compreensão de desenvolvimento de negócios serão consideradas um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente ou avançado é obrigatório (para interação diária com a liderança global e parceiros internacionais). Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Bacharelado em Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Economia, Direito ou áreas afins.


Por que trabalhar conosco?


Os talentos que contratamos atuam como One Team, colaborando entre fronteiras, culturas e funções para alcançar o sucesso compartilhado. Eles adotam o Ask Why, desafiando premissas e investigando a fundo para descobrir a raiz de cada problema. São movidos por Innovation To Win, inquietos na busca por soluções ousadas e criativas, e possuem um Ownership Mindset, agindo diretamente para entregar resultados em vez de esperar por direcionamento. Usamos Lead By Data como nossa bússola, mas Design For People como nossa estrela-guia, porque tudo o que criamos deve tornar a vida mais simples, inteligente e humana. Se você se identifica com esse perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você.

  • Liderança com Alta Visibilidade: Posição executiva sênior com forte impacto estratégico e responsabilidade regulatória.
  • Flexibilidade de Trabalho Remoto: Modelo flexível para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Oportunidades claras de progressão de carreira à medida que a operação no Brasil escala.

title: Aviation Specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist


About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006.”


The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer .


The contract will require the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific . The intended start date is January 2027 , with an implementation period of 48 months .


In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the aviation sector.


Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of aviation infrastructure and air transport projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting airport master planning, infrastructure development and air connectivity planning.
  • Advising on airport infrastructure, airport systems, air transport services and operational efficiency.
  • Supporting aviation safety, security and compliance with relevant international and European standards and good practices.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, and operation and maintenance planning for aviation infrastructure.
  • Promoting sustainable and low-carbon aviation, including measures to improve energy efficiency and reduce the environmental footprint of airport operations.
  • Integrating climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and environmental and social considerations into aviation infrastructure planning and investment.
  • Supporting policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the aviation sector.
  • Contributing to the assessment and improvement of investment climates and regulatory frameworks for aviation infrastructure and services.
  • Providing capacity building and technical assistance to civil aviation authorities, airport operators, public institutions and other sector stakeholders.
  • Coordinating with public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.
  • Supporting the promotion and adoption of European standards and good practices in partner countries.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Master’s degree or equivalent diploma in aeronautical engineering, airport engineering, civil engineering, transport engineering, aviation management , or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the aviation sector, including airports, air transport, aviation safety, air connectivity and sustainability aspects , as well as related policies and international good practices.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.


General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the aviation sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of aviation infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to aviation infrastructure and services delivery, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability considerations.


Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of aviation infrastructure, airport systems and/or air transport services.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in aviation projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America or Asia .
  • Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the aviation sector, in particular on the technical side, such as feasibility studies, project design, airport planning, aviation safety, social and environmental issues, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, operational efficiency and resilience, etc.


Assets

  • Professional experience in the Sub-Saharan Africa region (in situ).
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the aviation sector.
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.


Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.


Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Transport Experts
description:
Transport Experts – Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2


About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.


NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006 .”


The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer .


The contract is expected to start in January 2027 and will have an implementation period of 48 months . Experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance assignments globally, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific .


We are seeking experienced professionals across a broad range of transport and mobility disciplines to join our Transport Experts Talent Pool .


Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation, appraisal and implementation of transport and connectivity projects.
  • Conducting prefeasibility and feasibility studies, technical assessments, economic and financial analyses, and sector studies.
  • Supporting transport infrastructure planning, design, rehabilitation, modernisation and investment planning.
  • Assisting public authorities and transport institutions in developing policies, strategies, regulatory frameworks and sector reform programmes.
  • Supporting the preparation of transport investment pipelines aligned with Global Gateway and European Green Deal priorities .
  • Advising on sustainable, low-carbon, smart, safe, resilient and inclusive transport solutions.
  • Supporting multimodal transport, logistics connectivity and integration between different transport modes.
  • Assessing investment climates and identifying opportunities for public and private sector participation, including PPPs.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, contract management, implementation supervision, and operation and maintenance planning.
  • Supporting the application and promotion of European and international transport standards and good practices.
  • Contributing to institutional strengthening, knowledge creation, training and capacity-building activities.
  • Facilitating coordination between public authorities, EU Delegations, IFIs, infrastructure operators, private sector stakeholders and development partners.


Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in transport, infrastructure, mobility, logistics, connectivity or related sectors, with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

Road and highway infrastructure;

Railway infrastructure, operations, interoperability and signalling;

Ports, maritime transport and inland waterways;

Aviation and airport infrastructure;

Urban mobility and public transport;

Logistics corridors and freight transport;

Multimodal transport and regional connectivity;

Transport planning and infrastructure asset management;

Transport economics, demand analysis and modelling;

Sustainable and low-carbon transport;

E-mobility and transport decarbonisation;

Transport safety;

Climate-resilient transport infrastructure and disaster risk reduction;

Infrastructure project preparation, feasibility studies and project appraisal;

Construction supervision and quality assurance;

Transport sector policy, regulation and institutional reform;

Infrastructure finance, PPPs and private sector participation;

Procurement, contract management and FIDIC;

Environmental and social aspects of transport infrastructure.

  • Experience in international technical assistance, donor-funded and/or IFI-financed projects is highly desirable.
  • Professional experience in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and/or Asia and the Pacific will be considered a strong asset.
  • Familiarity with EU transport policies, Global Gateway, the European Green Deal, G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment and international infrastructure standards is advantageous.
  • Experience working with public authorities, transport agencies, infrastructure operators, IFIs, development partners and/or private sector stakeholders is desirable.
  • Strong analytical, coordination, stakeholder engagement and reporting skills.


Language Requirements

  • Excellent command of English is required.
  • Knowledge of French and/or Spanish will be considered a strong asset depending on the assignment.


Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
